title: Egg Toast
description: A simple breakfast recipe consisting of toasted bread topped with a fried egg.
instructions: Toast 2 slices of bread until lightly browned.
Crack 1 egg into a non-stick pan coated with butter.
Cook the egg over medium heat until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to your desired doneness.
Place the toasted bread on a plate and top with the fried egg.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
